_README: THE HOOK REEL. website/videos.html reads this file and pairs each entry
with its video in data/channel.json by id, so the thumbnail, title, link
and view count always come from the published record. This file carries
only what channel.json cannot: a one-line hook.
VOICE (the owner's call, 2026-11-01). Each line works as a hook, not as a
summary. It should make a stranger want the video. The first pass read
like a machine restating the title back at itself; that got cut.
THREE RULES THAT DO NOT BEND:
1. E-Prime, as everywhere in this repo. No is/are/was/were/be/been/
being/am. The owner also reads this as defamation cover: it is NOT.
E-Prime softens how a claim reads, and carries no legal weight at
all. The protection comes from rules 2 and 3.
2. No checkable factual claim about a named living person. Not their
health, their money, their substance use, their state of mind, or
what they did. The channel's titles may rib somebody; a hook written
here for the site makes a NEW assertion in the site's own voice, and
the site carries it. Videos about named individuals therefore stay
out of this reel until the owner decides otherwise.
3. Where a line ribs anything at all, the section framing above it says
plainly that the channel plays it as satire and good-natured fun.
See the #hooks section heading in videos.html; the two travel
together, so do not ship a hook without that framing on the page.
Every line here got written for the site, from the video's published
title in channel.json and nothing else. None quotes the owner, none draws
on the private script repo, and none claims to carry a transcript.
Fields on an entry:
id    the eleven-character YouTube id. It must appear in channel.json,
or the page skips the entry.
hook  one line, in the site's voice, that makes a stranger curious.
Keep the reel to six to ten entries, chosen from the most viewed videos.

entries.hook: The cartoon villain nobody took seriously keeps making more sense every year. Uncomfortable, that.
Quantum entanglement, morphic resonance, and a ringed planet walk into one argument. None of them leaves alone.
Sixteen years on autopilot, then the lights came on. An account of waking up late.
The signs arrive early, loud, and almost comically on the nose. Most people file them under coincidence.
If the script already exists, what exactly do you think you decide? Free will takes a beating.
Admiration without ambition rots into worship. One honest way to honour a hero: beat them.
Three years of binaural meditation, logged daily. Here come the numbers, the unflattering ones included.
Forget the shadow government. Follow the org chart, and the pyramid turns out to mean what it looks like.
